title: Comparison of logarithmic bounds
statement: For every $n\in\mathbb N$, the logarithmic space bound $\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1$ is at most $1+h(n)$, where $h(0)=0$ and $h(n)=\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1$ for $n>0$.
replaced:
For every natural number $n$, the logarithmic space bound $\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1$ is
at most $1+h(n)$, where $h(0)=0$ and $h(n)=\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1$ for $n>0$.
